info.title: LabKit graph API
info.description: Read-only HAL+JSON view of the LabKit research graph. Each resource embeds its neighbours under `_embedded`, keyed `relation:type` for outbound links and `type:relation` for inbound ones.

get.summary: One graph entity and its neighbours

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Entity handle, e.g. Q_1, LOE_1, CLM_27.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: How many hops of neighbours to embed. 0 returns the entity alone.

200.description: The entity, with its properties beside id and type.

default.description: The handle is malformed or not in the graph, or depth is out of range.
